Amethyst Crystal Cluster Lot - 2 Pieces
Natural Mineral Specimens
Purple / Lavender, Druzy Geode Formations
Natural amethyst crystal clusters featuring dense druzy formations on a contrasting rocky matrix. These specimens display the characteristic transition from raw host stone to crystalline purple quartz. Ideal for mineral collectors or home decor, these pieces represent the natural beauty of geode interiors.
Pieces Included:
Amethyst Druzy Cluster: Deep purple crystal points with a thick rocky matrix base.
Amethyst Druzy Cluster: Lavender crystal points with a stable host stone matrix.
Natural crystalline druzy texture with varying shades of purple
Solid rock matrix bases providing stability for display
Combined weight of 1.75 lbs; pair measures approximately 6x5x3 inches
Condition:
Specimens in excellent natural condition. Well-preserved crystal terminations with no post-extraction damage. The matrix is stable and free of crumbling. Natural geological variations in color and structure are present as expected.
